L18: # Complan Original
L19: 
L20: Complan Original is our versatile neutral drink - it can be enjoyed as a delicious drink or used like milk throughout the day. What a great way to add extra vitamins and minerals to your diet.
L21: 
L22: With protein which contributes to the growth and maintenance of muscle mass and 26 vitamins and minerals:
L23:   * Vitamin C, zinc and iron which contribute to the normal functioning of the immune system
L24:   * Calcium, vitamin D and magnesium which contribute to the maintenance of normal bones
L25:   * Vitamins B2, B6 and B12 which contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue
L26: ### Preparation
L27: 
L28: ### You will need:
L29: 
L30:   * 200ml (1/3 pint) of water or milk (cold or warm)
L31:   * A whisk or fork
L32:   * A glass or mug
L33:   * 60g (4 rounded tablespoons) of Complan Original
L34: ### Ready in three simple steps:
L35: 
L36:   1. Measure out 200ml (1/3 pint) of cold milk or water. Then pour a small amount of it into a glass.
L37:   2. Add 60g (4 rounded tablespoons) of Complan to the small amount of milk or water and blend into a paste using a fork or whisk. This paste can be added to soups, stews, mashed potato and other foods, or for a drink, follow step 3.
L38:   3. Pour in the rest of the milk or water, stir well and enjoy your delicious drink.
L39: 
L40: you can add it to anything
L41: ### Ingredients
L42: Ingredients: Skimmed milk (44%), maltodextrin, vegetable oils (palm oil, sunflower oil), glucose syrup, magnesium hydrogen phosphate, calcium carbonate, sodium L-ascorbate, flavouring (milk), taurine, L-ascorbic acid, ferrous sulphate, zinc sulphate, choline chloride, DL-alpha-tocopherol, nicotinamide, DL-alpha-tocopheryl acetate, calcium D-pantothenate, copper sulphate, retinyl palmitate, riboflavin, thiamin hydrochloride, manganese sulphate, pyridoxine hydrochloride, pteroylmonoglutamic acid, phytomenadione, chromium chloride, sodium molybdate, potassium iodide, sodium selenite, cholecalciferol, D-biotin, cyanocobalamin.

L98: **Per 55g serving - 8 scoops (when mixed with 200ml semi-skimmed milk). Available as a 425g pack.
L99: 
L100: Store in a cool, dry place. Use within one month of opening. Once made up, Complan can be enjoyed as a delicious drink used like milk throughout the day. Complan can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
L101: A serving refers to 8 scoops (approx. 55g) mixed with 200 ml semi-skimmed milk, per day. Suggested intake for adults: 1-2 servings/day. People with diabetes and pregnant women should consult their dietitian or doctor before including as part of their diet.
